name: Yoshino
text: Yoshino (吉野町, Yoshino-chō) is a town located in Yoshino District, Nara Prefecture, Japan. As of 30 September 2024, the town had an estimated population of 5,874 in 2,997 households, and a population density of 61 persons per km2. The total area of the town is 95.65 km2 (36.93 sq mi).
